senses.zh_definition: （仅在确指专有人名 Celia 时）西莉亚，女性名字；此释义不构成对小写 celia 作为标准马来语普通词的确认。
senses.en_definition: When referring to the proper name Celia: a female given name; not a verified Malay common-word sense.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk nama khas Celia: nama perempuan. Huraian ini ialah penjelasan editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP bagi kata umum celia.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有提供词义、读音或爪夷文，因此不能可靠标为 official。马来西亚资料确有人名 Celia，但这只支持专名用法；以下搭配和例句均为该用法的示例，不声称是高频普通词搭配。[人名实证：霹雳州律师公会报告](https://perakbar.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/AGM-REPORT-2024-2025.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: If the intended item is the personal name Celia, name dictionaries connect it with the Roman family name Caelius and note its appearance in Shakespeare's As You Like It. That history belongs to the name, however, and cannot establish an etymology for an unidentified Malay common word spelled celia. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/celia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若原文确指人名，可记 Celia＝西莉亚；不要把它与 ceria（开朗、愉快）混记。
